prompt_text: The post text claims one music genre is more popular than another. Look at the percentage values in the chart to verify this claim. If the genre described as more popular in the text has a higher percentage in the chart, reply 'correct'. If not, reply 'incorrect'.

answers.post_claim_correct:

From the chart:
- Latin has a percentage of 11.0%.
- Pop has a percentage of 23.5%.

Since 11.0% (Latin) is not greater than 23.5% (Pop), the claim is incorrect.
